hints.title: Consecutive Zero Streaks
hints.text: A streak of k consecutive zeros contributes k * (k + 1) // 2 zero-filled subarrays.

hints.title: Running Count Contribution
hints.text: At each consecutive zero encountered, increment the current streak length and add it directly to total.

hints.title: Reset on Nonzero
hints.text: When an element is nonzero, reset the current streak counter to zero.

hints.title: Linear Streak Counter Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass accumulating running zero streak length.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Two integer accumulator variables in constant memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies that a streak of length k adds k subarrays ending at current position.
